Australian Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Australia comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Australian documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Australian Passport Office180–620 AUD
Driving Licencethe state transport authority110–430 AUD
ID Cardthe state transport authority80–290 AUD
Green Cardthe Department of Home Affairs320–1050 AUD
Visathe Department of Home Affairs150–540 AUD
Residence Permitthe Department of Home Affairs300–880 AUD

Two checks specific to Australia

  • Confirm the state crest and the state licence number pattern, which differs in every state and territory.
  • Check the passport for the kangaroo and emu watermark and the intaglio printing on the data page.

Local red flag

  • A card that lists an address in a state other than the one in the header.
